protocol.workload: original Stage B/C/D dev inputs and identical evenly spaced 128 queries
protocol.million_fp32_allocation: actual attempt even when payload exceeds free GPU memory; capture CUDA OOM
protocol.memory_baseline: same official B0 model parameters + normalized queries + resident video index + scratch, as Stage C/D; encoder execution excluded from search timer
protocol.expansion: physical cyclic copies with per-video valid lengths; no accuracy on expansions
protocol.controls: user requested B0 and uniform32 throughput remeasurement in the same CUDA process under current host CPU/IO load
protocol.interference_policy: interrupt, discard attempt, exit CUDA context and wait fresh 300 seconds
